development_data.name: General-AgentBench published baseline prompts
development_data.usage: Router V7 may fit on these development prompts only. No Router V2-V6 external holdout task is reused for V7 scoring.

sampling_rule:
Load both pinned AssistantBench JSONL files, deduplicate by id, compute SHA256(id + '
' + task), sort ascending by digest, and select the first 72. The rule is fixed before the first successful score.
label_visibility: The search family label is attached only after Router V6 and Router V7 predictions are produced.
primary_metric: Search-family Hit@1 over the 72-task AssistantBench holdout
secondary_metrics: Router V6 Hit@1 on the identical new holdout
anti_tuning_rule: After the first successful scored run, Router V7 algorithm, weights, source pin, sampling rule, and task count are frozen for this holdout. Any changed router must become Router V8 with a new holdout.
evidence_boundary: This is task-family routing transfer only. It does not claim AssistantBench answer accuracy, web browsing correctness, source quality, or end-to-end research completion.
